metadata.document_title: The Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017

article.title: Amendment of Act 32 of 1994.
article.content:
173Amendment of Act 32 of 1994.

Section 173  ·  Chapter XXI  ·  page 123 of the Act
Save as otherwise provided in this Act, Chapter V of the Finance Act, 1994 (32 of 1944) shall be omitted.
